title: Voynich Manuscript v3.1 Confirmatory Self-Citation Test Results
summary: This public results release reports a preregistered test of the Timm–Schinner generator. The study compares simulations against four manuscript statistics covering CHEDY and QOK adjacency, combined family abundance and the frequency of close neighbors of common words.
established: Across 300 preregistered configurations and three fixed seeds per configuration, no configuration matched more than two of the four target metrics. Sixteen matched two, 183 matched one, and 101 matched zero.

The preregistered sensitivity analyses using wider reference bands and interior token positions also produced no complete matches. The result is scoped to the registered configuration sampling distribution.

open.question: Can a related copying mechanism outside the sampled subspace match the four registered family and neighbor metrics simultaneously under a fresh, fixed evaluation?
open.check: Declare the rule and sampling plan first, then evaluate all four statistics on fixed seeds and report how often they fall inside the registered bands jointly.
